title: Early shuttle crews borrowed yellow U-2/SR-71 suits from Beale
place_text: Beale Air Force Base / Kennedy Space Center

tellings.quote: they had to go to Beal Air Force Base and borrow the yellow space suits that the U2 and SR71 guys fly.

plain: For the first space shuttle flights in 1981, the astronauts Young and Krippen had to go to Beale Air Force Base and borrow the yellow pressure suits worn by pilots of the U-2 and SR-71, two high-flying spy planes. The NASA doctor Greg Rogers tells this, passing on what he was told. It shows how much NASA borrowed from secret military flying in the early shuttle days.
